hero.title: Sappa.
hero.lede: Acoustic panels grown from hemp — one of today's most sustainable raw materials, bound with a cement-free mineral binder. For walls and ceilings, brought to Denmark by Beyond Rational.

points.title: A fast-renewing raw material
points.body: Hemp needs little water, no pesticides, and reaches full height in months, not years — capturing atmospheric carbon roughly twice as efficiently as forestry across its growing cycle. A rapidly renewable material, by nature.

points.title: Zero-waste by construction
points.body: The panels are pressed from stem chips — the residue left over once fibre is stripped from the plant for other industrial uses. Material that would otherwise be discarded becomes the product.

points.title: Cradle to cradle
points.body: A cement-free mineral binder holds the hemp chips together, with no synthetic flame retardants added — naturally fire-resistant, fully recyclable. A complete cradle-to-cradle design.

rows.value: Naturally fire-resistant — no flame retardants added
